svg.title: Enterprise coding delivery architecture
svg.desc: OpenSpec supplies the spec. Agentic Engineering manages human approval, one-time authorization, and delivery decisions. Coding agents and CI supply changes and evidence. The implemented foundation is shown at the bottom.

g.font-family: system-ui, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
g.text: Enterprise coding delivery architecture
Target design · from specification to controlled execution and review
Ticket / PRD / defect report → OpenSpec
Single spec entry point · deltas, acceptance scenarios, and tasks
Delivery controls · Agentic Engineering
Execution and verification
Workflow orchestration and approval
Human approval for the spec revision and scope
Coding agent · TDD in a sandbox
Run a failing test, implement, and rerun tests
Patch execution grant
One use · spec revision and patch digest
Restricted executor
Apply the patch and capture the commit and diff
Delivery gate
Check diff, acceptance, and regression evidence
CI · Independent build and verification
Bind evidence to the exact candidate commit
GO · Prepare a review packet
Spec, actual diff, evidence, and gate decision
Human code review and merge approval
NO_GO · Pause delivery
Add evidence, narrow scope, or seek reapproval
Implemented foundation
Typed protocols and JSON Schemas · SQLite gate history and restart recovery
